'''Mallone''' is a [[Whitecloak]].

==Activities==
Mallone was one of the best men suggested by [[Golever]] to [[Galad]] when he was ordered to reach [[Hawal Ford]] by [[Mat]].

== Trivia ==
* Mallone is named for Ramsey Malone Burt, and his name was submitted by Jonathan Burt, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
